Title: Public preview of Azure PostgreSQL backup with long term retention

Body.Content:
Azure Backup and Azure Database Services bring to you a new backup solution for your PostgreSQL servers that retains backups for up to 10 years.

In preview, you now have access to features such as:

  • RBAC based access to the database using AAD authentication
  • Customer controlled scheduled and ad-hoc backup at individual database level
  • Database-level restores to any Postgres server (any db version) or blob storage
  • Long term retention in vault or Archive tier
  • Backups stored in a separate security and fault domain
  • Central Monitoring of all operations & jobs

Learn more.
